title: SourceReference
description: Portable research reference to one retrieved (or attempted) source embedded in an Evidence Pack. Not a full source database schema.

source_id.description: Stable ID within the pack, e.g. S001, R003.

url.description: Exact retrieved URL where applicable; null for seed-local evidence.

discovery_method.description: Deterministic derivation rule, e.g. SCANNER_REFERENCE_TRAVERSAL, PURL_DERIVED_MAVEN_PATH, RUNTIME_URL_DERIVATION, ADVISORY_QUERY.

parent_source_id.description: Parent record ID; null only for seed roots.

parent_evidence.description: Seed field or record the root derives from, e.g. PATCH_REASONING_SEED:TRIVY_BEFORE#CVE-2099-0001.

content_sha256.description: Hash of retrieved bytes; required when status is RETRIEVED.

allowed_operations.description: E.g. metadata, pom, artifact, checksum for registry roots.

used_for_fields.description: Proposal field names this source may support.
